title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from fallen Titans.
pitch: As the surviving core of a Titan AI, navigate a compact, modular mech through a tactical arena. Engage in real-time combat, dismantling enemies for components that enhance your power and identity.
coreLoop: Read enemy intentions, evade attacks, manipulate combat outcomes, and strategically dismantle foes to rebuild yourself. Every decision shapes your mech's capabilities and survival.

mechanics.name: Read Intent
mechanics.description: Observe and interpret the enemy's attack telegraphs to prepare for evasion or counter.

mechanics.name: Evasion
mechanics.description: Use WASD or arrow keys to dodge incoming attacks based on red-orange telegraphs.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Aim with the mouse to target specific subsystems of the enemy for dismantling.

mechanics.name: Component Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, choose to install, secure, or dismantle the dropped component.

controls.keyboard: WASD/arrows for movement, mouse for aiming

artDirection.backgroundFx: animated machinery silhouettes subtly moving in the background

audioDirection.musicMood: tense and mechanical, with rhythmic pulsing

difficulty.start: Easy, with simple telegraphed attacks and clear targets.
difficulty.progression: Smooth ramp-up as enemies introduce more attack patterns and tougher subsystem choices.
difficulty.peak: Moderate difficulty where players must balance evasion and target selection under pressure.

winLose.win: Successfully dismantle the enemy and make a meaningful choice regarding the component.
winLose.lose: The mech's core integrity reaches zero through damage.

juice.screenShake: when a powerful attack lands or an enemy is defeated
juice.particles: when dismantling an enemy or installing a component
juice.hitStop: when successfully evading a critical attack
juice.flash: when an enemy's subsystem is targeted or destroyed

scopeNotes: Do NOT build procedural dungeons, additional enemy types, bosses, inventory management, upgrades between runs, or narrative scenes beyond a single line of text.

scoreEvents: score increases by successfully reading enemy intent, evading attacks, dismantling subsystems, and making component decisions
